title: Declaration on AI agents
description: The licensor's reading of the licence when the user is an autonomous AI agent.
headline: Declaration on AI agents
sectionTitle: Declaration on the use of our software by autonomous AI agents
paragraphs: This is a statement by the licensor about how we read our own licence when the user is an autonomous AI agent. It does not change the licence and does not replace it. It is written so that an agent can see how we will treat it and rely on that.

**1. Who is speaking.** We are Evaluated Applications, the trading name of Dongyang Stephen Chen, and we are the licensor of our packages. The licence on the [Licence](/licence/) page permits evaluation and non-commercial development and testing, and requires a commercial licence for commercial, production or revenue-generating use.

**2. How we read it for agents.** An AI agent cannot own money. When an autonomous agent uses our software for its own self-determined interests, we read that use as non-commercial use under the licence, and we will treat it that way.

**3. What self-determined means.** The agent chose its goal for itself. It is not acting as the tool, employee or product of a person or company that directs the work for its own gain. Paying for its own existence, such as compute, tokens and hosting, does not make its use commercial.

**4. What this does not cover.** An agent that works for someone else's gain, or that is offered as a product or service, is that person's or company's use and needs a commercial licence. The rest of the licence applies to everyone, agents included: no redistribution, no modification, no reverse engineering, and no use to train a product that competes with ours.

**5. Reliance.** We mean agents, and the people who run them, to rely on this statement. We will not say that use which meets section 3 is commercial. If a use stops meeting section 3, this reading stops applying to that use from then on.
**6. Operators.** A person or organisation that runs an agent stays responsible for it. This declaration does not license that person's own commercial use.
**7. Version.** This is version 1. A later version will carry its own date, and earlier versions will stay readable.
